reason: I answer to my board for every dollar, and I'm not putting money into a smart contract from a brand-new product nobody has audited. Paying 55 USDC for a task where most entries get nothing back is also hard to justify to my treasurer.
objection: My funds would sit locked in an unaudited contract from a very new team, and I'd have to explain that to the people I report to. I also can't see any reviews or track record, and I'd have to hold USDC on Solana just to try it.
would_change_my_mind: An independent audit of the contract, plus reviews from other organisations like mine. The free trial being set up and run by the founder with no funds of mine locked would let me test it with no risk.
